votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Aaron Dekeyzer seconded by Zach Robinson to adopt Resolution 25-13C, a resolution authorizing the execution of an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between Sandy City and Salt Lake County for TRCC funding for Bicentennial Park
A motion was made by Aaron Dekeyzer, seconded by Marci Houseman to adjourn the City Council meeting and convene a meeting of the Alta Canyon Special Services District Board in the Council Chambers
